PR: Fix "IP only" certificates with IP in common name [closed; labels release-note, approved, lgtm, kind/bug, size/M, area/acme, dco-signoff: yes, ok-to-test]
### Pull Request Motivation

this pr fixes the issue if you need to use an ip address as common name in subject literal in combination with acme protocol if you only use ip addresses.

csr example:
Subject: C=us, O=organization, OU=unit, CN=1.2.3.4
X509v3 Subject Alternative Name:
IP Address:1.2.3.4

the common name has to be validated if it is an ip or a dns name and than put it in the right identifierSet instead always to type dns.

be…

{"identifiers":[{"type":"dns","value":"1.2.3.4"},{"type":"ip","value":"1.2.3.4"}]}

after change acme payload --> ok:
{"identifiers": [{"type":"ip","value":"1.2.3.4"}]}

### Kind
bug

### Release Note

```release-note
Fix handling of certificates with IP addresses in the `commonName` field; IP addresses are no longer added to the DNS `subjectAlternativeName` list and are instead added to the `ipAddresses` field as expected.
```
